_note: KPI/feature targets for routing AI-agent sessions. Derived from the Enterprise Feature Discovery Catalog (new-business / expansion / renewal / deal-size). 'channel' crosswalks each KPI to the signature channel it is scored against. 'match_target' is the catalogue-style yes/no judge question. 'keywords' back the lightweight lexical stand-in encoder (swappable for BGE).

targets.label: New-business acquisition
